Mean \(=\dfrac{2+4+6+8}{4}=5\). The deviations from the mean are \(-3,-1,1,3\), whose squares are \(9,1,1,9\) and sum to \(20\). Variance \(=\dfrac{20}{4}=5\). Matches option D: \(5\).

(The sample variance \(\dfrac{20}{3}\approx 6.67\) is likewise not among the options, so the intended reading is the population variance either way. The previously stored key, \(8\), is not attainable under either convention.)

Line 1 passes through the origin with direction \(\vec{b_1}=(2,2,4)\); line 2 passes through \((4,4,5)\) with direction \(\vec{b_2}=(-2,8,5)\).

\(\vec{b_1}\times\vec{b_2}=\big(2(5)-4(8),\ 4(-2)-2(5),\ 2(8)-2(-2)\big)=(-22,-18,20)\), so \(|\vec{b_1}\times\vec{b_2}|=\sqrt{484+324+400}=\sqrt{1208}\approx 34.756\).

With \(\vec{a_2}-\vec{a_1}=(4,4,5)\): \((\vec{a_2}-\vec{a_1})\cdot(\vec{b_1}\times\vec{b_2})=4(-22)+4(-18)+5(20)=-60\).

Shortest distance \(=\dfrac{|-60|}{\sqrt{1208}}\approx 1.726\), which lies in \([1,2)\). Matches option C.

(Confirmed independently by minimising \(|(\vec{a_1}+s\vec{b_1})-(\vec{a_2}+t\vec{b_2})|\) numerically, which returns the same \(1.7263\).)
